session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Bull Trend Resumption' (filename: 2nd-leg bull trap and then bull trend resumption; agreement). Spans 4/1 13:00 through 4/2 13:40 (plain-PT style with day-roll edge markers). Reading: DB/HL MTR at the 4/1 2436 low turned the tape up, the 2nd leg down at 4/2 07:00 to 2440 was a bear trap, a bull major surprise breakout swept the open to 2531, an Exp Tri formed in the 07:40-08:00 push, a pullback to 1 (2485) preceded the LH MTR down at 2515 (red line), and the bear trend into the 2 wedge low (2460) grew a Big High 2 pullback in bull trend that resumed the bull trend into the 4/2 close at ~2525.
